title: Enforce redacted browser capture artifacts

gates.name: browser_capture_redaction
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/browser-capture.spec.ts

verify: Independent corpus verification exercises screenshot/trace/video/DOM artifacts through one helper, proves raw secret/auth absence and source-fixture integrity, validates safe failure, and rejects direct capture calls or a product screenshot feature.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-008 / REQ-020 RED: no frontend/capture helper currently exists to exercise the browser boundary; GREEN: every registered capture artifact omits the configured secret/auth corpus, source fixtures remain unchanged, unsafe capture fails with a stable safe error, and no direct capture/product feature exists; decisive comparison: artifact corpus scan, source-value probe, helper-usage scan, and failure transcript; artifact: capture evidence under .tasks/TASK-094-T3-FT-016-W4/.
purpose: Apply the FT-015/AD-012 Product Surface Redaction handoff to the actual FT-016 browser evidence surface without creating product screenshot functionality.
success_outcome: All FT-016 Playwright browser artifacts are created through one safe helper and contain no configured secret/auth value, while source values remain unchanged and direct/product capture paths are absent.
anti_goals: Do not add a user-facing screenshot button, upload endpoint, production capture service, generic free-text pipeline, or secret-bearing browser configuration.
Do not mutate source credentials or clean an artifact only after unsafe capture.

forbidden_scope: secret/auth values in browser config/page data/artifacts
source credential mutation or external upload
stop_conditions: A raw configured secret/auth value reaches any capture input or artifact.
Safe capture requires exposing backend/provider credentials to the browser or adding product capture authority.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA browser verification; Runtime Substrate remains the shared backend sanitizer owner only.
Redact or omit before capture, preserve source values, and route every artifact through one registered helper.
invariants: Secrets, tokens, cookies, auth headers, passwords, private env, backend origin, and provider credentials never enter browser artifacts.
Capture redaction grants no upload, sync, UI, agent, or domain authority.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-008 / REQ-020: configured auth/secret corpus absence across screenshot/trace/video/DOM, source integrity, safe failure, helper exclusivity, and no product capture.
T3 harm proof uses disposable fixtures/browser artifacts, safe rerun, and cleanup that preserves only required redacted evidence.
